surface: Library question desk and homepage question continuation

readerContract.humanQuestion: Can I find a useful explanation for my AI question here?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Read relevant LAiDIES explanations with exact section links and understand when they cover only part of the question.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: Adult beginner with an ordinary question; no catalogue or technical vocabulary assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Initial search retrieves admitted explanations without inventing tailored advice or silently making a model call.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A visitor needs to understand an AI term or check how to handle a work document.
readerContract.surfaceJob: Match the current free-search service and preserve the question beside useful excerpts.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I understand what this material tells me and can open its full explanation.

patternsNotToCopy: Dream Phone nostalgia, humour, or gameplay claims

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: The desk searches existing LAiDIES explanations and shows their source; a match may cover only part of the question.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A context-window question retrieves the admitted dictionary explanation and opens its exact entry.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A work-document question preserves employer permission and sensitive-information conditions in the source excerpt.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Read the relevant excerpt and open the named section for its complete explanation.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Short desk invitation, bounded example question, retained question, search-result heading and relevant source cards.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No forced lesson, false direct-answer claim, unavailable research promotion or repeated slogan.
causalSequence: Visitor asks a question in ordinary words.
Free lookup finds existing admitted material without generating new advice.
The result shows excerpts with preserved conditions and exact routes.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: Search may still look like a personalized answer, truncate a condition, return a slogan or promote inactive research.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Inspect actual excerpt outputs for bounded and ambiguous questions; test zero AI calls, bad inputs, exact section routes, phone/desktop rendering and question retention.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: Useful attributed material, honest coverage, no automatic AI calls and working exact continuation.
